name: Drift car
description: A light rear-drive coupe set up to slide: drift and street-tuner builds. Less grip at the back, extra steering lock and the driver aids off, so it holds a slide on the throttle.
comment: A vehicle preset (#728); see sedan.json for the format. The base car is a 2022 Toyota GR86 automatic (#376 step 9b): 2851 lb curb, 53/47, 250 Nm at 3700 rpm and 228 hp at 7000, the 6-speed automatic's ratios and 3.90 axle; Car and Driver's test of the base car (6.1 s, 153 ft, 0.95 g) is reported, not judged. The drift setup: rear tires that grip no more than the front (tires.rearFriction, kept as the preset gives it rather than the cars' 1.05 of the friction: other cars' rears grip a tenth more than their fronts), so full throttle in a low gear breaks the rear loose, 55 degrees of steering lock (the real car has about 33), traction control and ABS off, and the brakes biased 75/25 to the front so a locked stop stays straight. The drive probe judges it on its own drift bars. Mantle has no limited-slip differential: every driven wheel gets the same torque, and a wheel never spins up on its own, so the outside rear keeps its half in a slide. The 7400 rpm limit and the torque curve between its two published points are estimates.
